task: Diagnose whether Prism can invoke Kimi through the current dispatcher without avoidable timeout.
user_intent: Norven observed direct Kimi CLI calls work and asked whether RedCap invokes Kimi incorrectly.
main_claim: The dispatcher should use a Kimi command compatible with the installed CLI and capture a session handle from the result.
changed_reality: Kimi text-mode CLI smoke returned quickly.
Kimi stream-json CLI smoke returned quickly.
The dispatcher command builder currently uses prompt mode, stream-json output, and --session for follow-up.

evidence.summary: Installed Kimi CLI supports -p/--prompt, -S/--session, -C/--continue, -y/--yolo, --auto, and --output-format text or stream-json.
Local dispatcher self-check passes before live Kimi smoke.

known_constraints: Do not allow Kimi to mutate the RedCap workspace during Prism review.
Do not treat a provider timeout as approval.
Keep the smoke request short so invocation failure is not confused with broad review complexity.
